venues.proceedings_hint: PMLR volume listed on https://proceedings.mlr.press/ (ICML 2026 = v306), usually around the conference (July).

papers.nips.cc /paper_files/paper/<year> listing, track 'conference' (titles/authors/links, no abstracts; conference_site ids). Main track appears months after the conference; until then only the virtual-site Downloads export (design 52 D6).
proceedings.iclr.cc /paper_files/paper/<year> listing (titles/authors/links, no abstracts; conference_site ids). 2025: 3,703 and 2026: 5,351 papers on 2026-10-11.
ACL Anthology XML <year>.acl.xml on GitHub (acl-org/acl-anthology data/xml), CC BY 4.0.
CVF Open Access /CVPR<year> listing (titles/authors/links only, no abstracts).
CVF Open Access /ICCV<year> listing (titles/authors/links only, no abstracts).
ECVA papers.php section 'ECCV <year> Papers' (titles/authors/links, no abstracts; conference_site ids). ECCV 2026 not there yet on 2026-10-11; the virtual-site Downloads export has it (design 52 D6).
COLM publishes on OpenReview only; needs design 52 D1/D2.
